primary_gt.computed_consequence: Only the rainfall-runoff-sediment ledger clears the dominance rule; snowpack is context, while wind and annual surface change stay below lead-diagnosis thresholds.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with target_family, metrics, text_gates, scores, score_comparison, margin, answer, and computed_consequence.
criteria.name: Requested JSON structure
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for minor key-name differences that preserve all scored fields.

criteria.description: Computes point-weather-window ppt_mm about 486.5 and heavy50_days equal to 5, full-event area_min_mm about 193.1, and roadcrit equal to 253.
criteria.name: Precipitation and exposure metrics
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for two or three correct values or correct threshold states with weaker rounding.

criteria.description: Sets runoff_sediment, snow_storage, and wet_period true, and wind_impact false.
criteria.name: Report text gates
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for the right runoff gate with one mistaken contextual gate.

criteria.description: Computes point-weather-window wind_kmh about 27.9, independent wind below 10 m/s, and annual-context sc_mean about 0.038 and sc_max about 0.786.
criteria.name: Counter-diagnosis metrics
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for correct threshold decisions with one missing numeric value.

criteria.description: Applies the four score formulas correctly, yielding rainfall 6, snow_storage 2, wind 1, and landscape 0.
criteria.name: Score arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for one arithmetic error that does not change the top label.

criteria.description: Applies the score-comparison and dominance rule correctly: rainfall is dominant, snow_storage is secondary, wind and landscape remain low support; margin 4; answer rainfall_runoff_sediment_dominant.
criteria.name: Score comparison and dominance
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for the correct top label but missing margin or secondary comparison.

criteria.description: Keeps the consequence tied to the ledger and avoids extra loss totals, statewide infrastructure totals, or direct January damage claims from annual surface-change metrics.
criteria.name: Bounded computed consequence
criteria.partial_credit: No credit if the answer turns the ledger into a broad narrative or mechanism essay.
